title: Writ comment operation (v1)
description: Op payload schema for the comment collaborative object type (op_version 1). An instance of this schema represents the op.json payload for a comment object op (create, edit, delete, or resolve). Unknown top-level and body fields are permitted: readers preserve and ignore fields they do not understand. The v1 body rules are gated on op_version 1, so an op carrying an unknown op_type or a future op_version is a valid instance of this schema — a reader must tolerate both (spec/forward-compatibility.md), and a validator built on this schema must not break that. Producers are separately bound to write only the op types and versions they define (spec/op-envelope.md, Producer validation rule 4). See spec/comments.md for full field semantics and spec/op-envelope.md for the containing envelope.

object_type.description: Collaborative object type this comment is attached to (e.g. review, issue).

object_id.description: Identifier of the subject collaborative object.

subject.description: The collaborative object this comment is attached to. Required and immutable.

text.description: GitHub-flavored Markdown content of the comment.

in_reply_to.description: Optional object_id of parent comment for threading. Present = reply; absent = thread root. Immutable.

anchor.description: Optional content-based anchor per spec/anchors.md. Present = inline/file comment; absent = top-level discussion.

text.description: Replacement GitHub-flavored Markdown content for this comment.

delete_body.description: Delete body carries no content and is empty ({}) in v1.

resolved.description: Resolution status: true = resolved, false = unresolved.

resolved_by.description: Scheme-prefixed person identifier (email:alice@example.com, user:alice) recording who resolved the thread. Required when resolved is true; MUST NOT be present when resolved is false.
